messages:
alex_chung: heads-up — ran cross-region latency/throughput sweep for the new 30B-quant build on A100 vs H100 yesterday. putting rough numbers here for sizing convo.

maria_gonzalez: awesome, can you paste the tail p99 numbers? trying to lock concurrency targets for Dedicated 30B pools.

alex_chung: p99 (seq=2048) A100 fp16: 420ms, A100 int8: 460ms. H100 fp16: 320ms, H100 int8: 370ms. throughput (tokens/s) steady-state per-GPU: A100 fp16 ~850, A100 int8 ~980, H100 fp16 ~1200, H100 int8 ~1400.

kevin_patel: interesting that int8 has higher throughput but worse p99 on A100. makes me think kernel fallback causing jitter. any kernel logs?

alex_chung: yep, saw occasional fallback to generic matmul for a few layers in int8 path on A100. added logs: "kernel_select: fallback_generic=true layer=18". on H100 int8 path used tensor cores consistently.

sarah_liu: do we have regional variance? eu-west vs us-west? might affect autoscale headroom from client latency.

alex_chung: eu-west cluster (same sku) showed +15% p99 vs us-west across the board, likely due to longer steady-state tails from px-networking + higher ambient util. link to charts: https://internal.figs/redwood/quant-sweep-1865 (placeholder)

maria_gonzalez: ok. for Dedicated sizing ask: target concurrency per-GPU? earlier rule-of-thumb was 4-6 for 30B. with these numbers what are we comfortable with for single-GPU latency SLO 500ms p99?

kevin_patel: quick calc: H100 int8 p99 370ms leaves ~130ms for queueing and network. I'd cap concurrency at 6 for H100 to keep buffer. A100 int8 p99 460ms — that's too close, drop to 3-4 concurrency or prefer fp16 kernels.

alex_chung: agreed. sim script I used: 
```\npython sim_capacity.py --gpu=A100 --kernel=int8 --model=redwood-30b --qps=2000 --concurrency=[2,3,4,6] --clients=200
```\noutput summary: concurrency 4 on A100 gives p99 ~540ms under 2k qps.

sarah_liu: what's our autoscale headroom policy? current Dedicated policy adds burst GPUs at 80% token-util. should we tune to region+kernel?

maria_gonzalez: suggest region_specific thresholds: us-west H100 85%, eu-west H100 78%, A100 70% for int8 kernels. this buys time for warmup and fallback reroute.

kevin_patel: also flag: int8 quant on A100 had a small quality regression on eval set (exact-match down 0.6%). not huge but documented. should we gate A100-int8 for prod Dedicated until eval checks pass?

alex_chung: good catch. I recommend staging A100-int8 in canary only, keep A100-fp16 and H100-int8 as main production variants. We can route by policy: prefer H100-int8 > A100-fp16 > A100-int8(fallback-only).

infra_bot: deploybot: canary rollout started for redwood-30b @ 1865001300 to ded-cluster-us-west (2 GPUs).

maria_gonzalez: for capacity planning spreadsheet I'll assume target concurrency per GPU: H100=6, A100-fp16=5, A100-int8=3. note reserved GPUs needed for headroom (30% extra) and 10% warm spare for region failover.

kevin_patel: question: do we want to prefer H100 in EU region despite cost? it gives better p99 and handles int8 kernels well.

alex_chung: cost vs latency tradeoff — for enterprise customers with strict SLOs use H100 pools. For lower tier, use A100-fp16 with tighter concurrency and autoscale. update plan in spreadsheet and tag customers by tier.

sarah_liu: can someone add a short note to the runbook about kernel fallback observability? last time it was noisy and we missed it.

alex_chung: will add. snippet I'll include: 
```\n# observability checks
- kernel_select metrics (counts, fallback_rate)
- per-layer exec_time distribution
- quant-quality-diff alerts (eval delta > 0.5%)
```\n
maria_gonzalez: perfect. I'll update Dedicated sizing doc and ping sales for potential pricing changes for H100 premium.

kevin_patel: tl;dr for ops: prefer H100 for 30B int8, cap A100-int8 concurrency to 3, set region thresholds and +30% headroom.

sarah_liu: thanks all. if canary healthy tomorrow we'll flip policy and update routing table. :thumbsup:

alex_chung: thanks — will post final numbers + csv tomorrow morning.
thread_summary: bench sweep for 30B quant across A100/H100, per-region p99 differences, kernel fallbacks on A100 int8, concurrency targets and autoscale headroom recommendations
